Subject: Re: Harrison Project Status Update

Hi Liam,

Thank you for the reminder. I am currently finalizing the architectural specifications for the Harrison project and will ensure all documents are submitted by next Friday.

Regarding the window designs, we have selected high-grade tempered glass as the transparent material to ensure both durability and clarity. I will include the detailed material specifications in the final report.

I will send over the status update for my department by the end of this week.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
</parameter>
